carrier_name: Mutual of Omaha (United of Omaha Life Insurance Company)

must_contain: United of Omaha Life Insurance Company

extraction_notes:
This is a multi-product Mutual of Omaha group insurance proposal (quote #24317905) for Bartel Communications, containing Basic Life/AD&D, Voluntary Life/AD&D, STD, LTD, Dental, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident, and Vision - each product is its own section starting with a bold header page (e.g. "VOLUNTARY CRITICAL ILLNESS INSURANCE") and an "Alternate:" number.

For CRITICAL ILLNESS specifically (found ~pages 16-20, Alternate 7.00):
- ELIGIBILITY section defines "Class 1: All Eligible Employees" - only one employee class in this doc.
- AMOUNTS OF INSURANCE table gives Min/Max/Increment/Guarantee Issue for 3 tiers: Employee/Member, Spouse, All Children (children coverage is automatic, no separate election/premium).
  - Employee/Member: Min $10,000, Max $20,000, Increment $10,000, GI $20,000
  - Spouse: Min $10,000, Max up to 100% of EE benefit up to $20,000, Increment $10,000, GI $20,000
  - Children: up to 25% of EE benefit up to $10,000, guaranteed (no increments, automatic)
- BENEFITS - CLASS 1 table lists a large Critical Illness Benefit table (Initial Benefit % of Principal Sum + Reoccurrence Benefit %) organized by category headers (Autoimmune, Cancers, Vascular/Pulmonary, Neurological, Organ) - this is benefit schedule detail, not rate table; recorded as descriptive product info, not part of age-banded rates.
- PREMIUM RATES table "CRITICAL ILLNESS PREMIUM RATES" gives a single age-banded rate-per-$1000 schedule labeled "Employee/Member* Monthly Rates per $1,000" with 7 bands: <30, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70-79, 80-99. Footnote clarifies these same rates apply to employee/member AND spouse (spouse uses employee's age). Child insurance is automatic with no separate premium - so Children class has no rate table (flat/zero).
- So there are 3 coverage classes total: Employee/Member (age-banded), Spouse (age-banded, same rate table as employee), All Children (flat/no premium, automatic amount).
- Rate Guarantee: 2 Years, Rate Guarantee Date 09/01/2028.
- Participation: 31% minimum, 104 eligible employees, 100% Employee/Member paid.
- Watch out: this document has MANY other products (Basic Life, Vol Life, STD, LTD, Dental x2 classes, Hospital Indemnity, Accident, Vision) that must be ignored if only Critical Illness is requested - they appear before and after the Critical Illness section and use similar formatting (Alternate #, ELIGIBILITY, BENEFIT SUMMARY, PARTICIPATION AND COST SUMMARY headers), so carefully identify only the "VOLUNTARY CRITICAL ILLNESS INSURANCE" header section by matching bold title text.
- Total count check for Critical Illness product: 1 product, 3 coverage classes (Employee/Member, Spouse, Children), each employee/spouse class has 7 age bands with 1 rate column (per $1,000) - no separate coverage-amount columns since it's a per-unit rate, not a rate grid.
